description: This Java class 'Animation2' is an Android Activity that demonstrates view animations, specifically using a ViewFlipper with different in/out animations based on user selection from a Spinner.

classes.name: Animation2
classes.description: An Android Activity that demonstrates changing view animations in a ViewFlipper based on user interaction with a Spinner.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the content view, and configures the ViewFlipper and Spinner with appropriate adapters and event listeners.

methods.name: onItemSelected
methods.description: Handles spinner selection events to set different in/out animations to the ViewFlipper based on selected position.

methods.name: onNothingSelected
methods.description: Handles the case when no spinner item is selected (no operation).
